observations: Red gas cylinder with two vertical handles.
The valve assembly is visible at the top.
The cylinder shows significant surface wear and paint chipping.
The cylinder is sitting inside a car trunk with other household items.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI NWOBODO PETER' is present on the image.

claims.evidence: The photo shows a 20kg cylinder, but the weight stamp on the metal is not legible.
This refers to the manufacturing origin and is not visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak, the valve is new.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be expired or past its re-test date.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the stamped date on the metal shroud.

risks.risk: The valve may be faulty or leaking.
risks.proof: A video showing a soap bubble test on the valve while the cylinder is held under pressure.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be empty or contain a different gas than specified.
risks.proof: A photo of the weight stamp on the cylinder body.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the stamped date on the cylinder shroud to confirm the expiry date.
Photo of the weight stamp on the cylinder body to confirm the actual capacity.
Video of a soap bubble leak test on the valve.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
